summary: Prepare experimental default-off shared replica appends with savepoint isolation, current-rule eligibility and writer diagnostics.

replay.detail: Existing Store construction leaves shared replica appends disabled; no startup replay or projection repair is activated.

schema.detail: No stored schema, indexes, migrations or user_version changes. Only opt-in multi-job transactions install temporary row triggers and a temporary witness table for WITHOUT ROWID writes; these are removed before COMMIT, with cleanup failure rolling back the transaction.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and RULES_VERSION remain unchanged. The exact eligibility allowlist is checked against the current drop-rule selector. Grouped signed envelopes retain all neighbours if future rules make an admitted kind droppable.

compatibility.detail: Default-off experimental opt-in changes new batch/claim IDs and hashes; old stored history and replication payload format are unchanged. Source-built previous-smallclaims component controls do not qualify deployed daemon artifacts or platforms. Every fleet member must run a build that passed the old-node gate before enabling; encoded size, fault persistence, native compatibility and performance gates remain open.

downtime.detail: No upgrade pause or coordinated restart is introduced while grouping remains disabled. Standard restart procedure applies; no outage or throughput measurements are claimed.

manual.detail: Keep shared replica grouping disabled. Enabling requires the documented correctness, old-node, retention, encoded-cap and measured single/concurrent latency gates; this draft is not activation guidance.

recovery.detail: Old history is not rewritten. If an experimental grouped batch has already been created, turning grouping off cannot restore its serial IDs. Persistent typed sealing-fault lifecycle and the encoded payload bound are unfinished; do not enable this draft on existing installations.
